diagnosis.missing_reader: The popup was admitted while its native frame tree still had an empty URL. Its first document committed during setup; the only context.js parse observed after attachment belonged to the hidden child frame. Subsequent reads had no content reply and no rows. A browser-free test reproduces admission on initial about:blank followed by commit and a missing receiver.
diagnosis.privacy_history: Earlier password-history refusals in this artifact belong to preceding review cases; none occurs among the final popup reads. They are not evidence that the popup lost password history. Recovery must preserve those refusals.
diagnosis.timeouts: Both policy artifacts and the PR external artifact completed all 80 browser cases, but their full Python output has no final OK. Docker exited 124 at the former 165-minute container deadline. No partial result is accepted.
diagnosis.fix: Recover only Chrome API missing-receiver rejection, inject ISOLATED reader/guard on the exact committed native document, and retain the first-act reload. Pin reads by native document ID. Full-fixture and qualification containers get 240 minutes within 250-minute jobs; no per-case deadline or assertion changes.
diagnosis.allowance: The lead committed PAUSE.md on top of f25ac736 with 174 used / about 185 allowed, directing this independent integration build to continue and fix failures within that allowance.
